title: It's OK to hardcode feature flags (2025)
summary: A contrarian blog post arguing that hardcoding feature flags directly in code is acceptable and often preferable to maintaining complex external configuration systems, challenging conventional wisdom about configuration management.
problem_solved: Addresses the over-engineering problem where teams build elaborate feature flag systems when simple hardcoded conditionals would suffice.
why_valuable: Offers a pragmatic counterpoint to industry dogma, advocating for simpler solutions that reduce complexity, external dependencies, and maintenance overhead.
